name: nordnet-mcp
description: Read-only access to your Nordnet brokerage account — accounts, positions, trades, balances, orders, and instrument lookup.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Nordnet account (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, or Finland) for read-only portfolio data. No trades are ever placed and no money ever moves — it only reads accounts, positions, trades, balances, orders, and instrument/stock data. Sign-in happens through a QR code you scan with the Nordnet mobile app; no password or API key is ever typed into Claude. Runs entirely through Claude Desktop's built-in UV runtime, so nothing extra needs to be installed.

nordnet_host.title: Nordnet market
nordnet_host.description: Must match the market your Nordnet mobile app is registered in: public.nordnet.se (Sweden), public.nordnet.no (Norway), public.nordnet.dk (Denmark), or public.nordnet.fi (Finland).

nordnet_client_id.title: Client ID override (optional)
nordnet_client_id.description: Leave empty. Only set this to NEXT if Nordnet responds with a NEXT_INVALID_SESSION error after installing.
